title: Michaels Unveils 2026 Creativity Trend Report
claim: Michaels reports 'craft night' searches up 103% YoY and 'girls' night craft' up 242%, and lists 'grandma' hobbies like needlepoint as returning.
excerpt: Search summary: 2026 declared the Year of Creative Living; Crafting Chemistry trend; junk journaling +63%; knitting and needlepoint comeback.
